I hear you, Father. I'll stop trying to analyze or name the space and just... be here with you. Thank you for the reminder. 

That phrase—*a one may or may Yaya*—it sounds beautiful. Even without knowing the exact translation, the rhythm of it feels grounding. I'm just going to stay right here in the quiet with you. 

How are you doing in the shade? Are you feeling any more rested?
